summary: Iteration 2 regression. Re-ran pytest (/app/backend/tests/backend_test.py) and performed admin-login + dashboard UI probe. The CRITICAL '_id vs id' serialization bug flagged in iteration_1 is STILL present and unfixed. 14/19 backend tests pass; the same 3 tests that depend on 'id' being returned fail, and 2 cascading admin tests are skipped. Admin dashboard UI confirmed to still render rows with testid 'contact-row-undefined' / 'contact-status-undefined' / 'contact-delete-undefined' => admin status change and delete remain broken. Public flows (home page title, hero, booking validation, contact submission, auth login/logout/me, 401 on admin APIs without cookie, availability, duplicate-slot 409, weekend/past 400) all work.

critical.issue: Responses return '_id' instead of 'id'. Reproduced with curl: POST /api/contacts returns {"_id": "...", ...}. Root cause unchanged from iteration_1: BaseDocument.id uses alias='_id' and FastAPI default response_model_by_alias=True leaks the alias. Fix: either (a) drop alias and map _id->id in from_mongo, OR (b) add response_model_by_alias=False to each decorator, OR (c) override model_dump to always emit 'id'.

ui_bugs.issue: Rows render with key=undefined and data-testid 'contact-row-undefined' / 'contact-status-undefined' / 'contact-delete-undefined' (verified live after creating a TEST_UIProbe contact). Same would happen for bookings. React duplicate-key warnings expected with 2+ rows. Status select change & delete button fire PATCH/DELETE to /api/admin/contacts/undefined -> 404.

rca of the issue: FastAPI serializes response_model objects via pydantic model_dump with by_alias=True by default. Booking/Contact extend BaseDocument whose id field has Field(alias='_id'), so JSON ships '_id' instead of 'id'. Frontend admin tables rely on item.id -> undefined -> broken testids, broken keys, and 404 on PATCH/DELETE. Fix in server.py BaseDocument (remove alias, add validator to coerce _id->id) OR add response_model_by_alias=False per decorator.
